channel.description: An automated daily audio briefing of global pork industry news, generated from a curated Notion news database.

item.title: August 25 Pork Industry News
item.description: US hog futures and cash prices moved on two USDA reports, Brazil's soybean market hit a multi-year high on tight supply and Chinese buying, and Spain reported a full week with no new African swine fever cases in one high-risk zone.

item.title: August 24 Pork Industry News
item.description: A light news day: a possible contraction in Denmark's pig herd size and its potential impact on the UK pork market.

item.title: August 22 Pork Industry News
item.description: African swine fever keeps spreading across Europe with new cases in Hungary, Poland, and Serbia, CME lean hog futures swing from a slide to a bounce, and JBS moves to fully absorb Pilgrim's Pride.

item.title: August 21 Pork Industry News
item.description: CME lean hog futures slip as China's Muyuan Foods posts a first-half loss and Brazilian hog prices sink below 2022-crisis levels, while African swine fever stays contained in Spain and a wave of Brazilian production, export, and food-safety news rounds out the day.

item.title: August 20 Pork Industry News
item.description: CME lean hog prices dip while a Texas A&M economist flags 25 straight months of farrow-to-finish profits, African swine fever spreads among Finland's wild boar, and a Proposition 12 fix drops out of the stalled Senate farm bill.

item.title: August 18 Pork Industry News
item.description: Japan's retail chicken and pork prices hit a record high in August 2026, driven by a weaker yen and rising production costs.

item.title: August 15 Pork Industry News
item.description: Lean hog futures and cash prices slide through the week while African swine fever developments unfold in Spain and South Africa, alongside a new US tariff on Chilean pork and a Brazilian court ruling on the soy moratorium.

item.title: August 13 Pork Industry News
item.description: Lean hog futures drift lower and African swine fever hits a Hungarian farm, while JBS posts record revenue alongside a net loss and Smithfield cuts its 2026 guidance.

item.title: August 12 Pork Industry News
item.description: JBS announces a global CEO transition and a $2.5 billion Indonesian joint venture, hog and pork prices swing across the U.S. and Brazil, and African swine fever spreads further in Spain and Italy.

item.title: August 10 Pork Industry News
item.description: U.S. hog futures and packer margins slide as a global pork supply glut weighs on prices, African swine fever containment continues in Germany and the Philippines, and U.S. pork exports and Tyson Foods post strong results.

item.title: August 9 Pork Industry News
item.description: New African swine fever cases hit Finland and South Korea while Estonia unveils a recovery plan, U.S. hog prices slide from their summer peak, and Tyson Foods settles a pork price-fixing lawsuit for $85 million.

item.title: August 3 Pork Industry News
item.description: Smithfield plans a $1.3 billion processing plant in South Dakota, new ASF outbreaks hit Poland and Germany, and USDA projects an 8% drop in EU pork exports as U.S. hog prices stay soft.

item.title: August 2 Pork Industry News
item.description: Finland confirms its first African Swine Fever case as global disease risk widens, U.S. hog prices swing between firming cutout values and softer futures, and China's pork imports slide over 26 percent while Europe faces new tariffs and 20-year-low prices.

item.title: July 31 Pork Industry News
item.description: U.S. hog prices and lean hog futures firm up even as African Swine Fever and foot-and-mouth risk rise worldwide, U.S. pork exports to Japan surge 20 percent, and Mexico lifts its Pseudorabies Virus restrictions on U.S. pork offal.

item.title: July 29 Pork Industry News
item.description: USDA trims its 2026 pork production and price outlook while hog prices and futures stay firm, global ASF and foot-and-mouth outbreaks hit record levels, and U.S.-China tariff talks advance as Smithfield announces a 1.3 billion dollar plant investment.

item.title: July 26 Pork Industry News
item.description: Trump slaps a new 50 percent tariff on Canadian goods and Chinese pork imports slide in the first half, while Japan's retail pork prices hit a record and Tyson settles a price-fixing suit for $85 million.

item.title: July 24 Pork Industry News
item.description: China suspends retaliatory pork tariffs and April exports rebound 33 percent, while African swine fever flares up in Spain, Germany, and South Korea.

item.title: July 23 Pork Industry News
item.description: Tight U.S. breeding herds keep hog prices elevated even as global oversupply warnings grow, African swine fever spreads in Germany and Poland, and China, Canada, and Mexico trade issues remain in focus.

item.title: July 22 Pork Industry News
item.description: African Swine Fever at record global risk, tight U.S. hog supply lifts prices, and China deepens oversupply.
